identity.title: Had enough of experts? Quantitative knowledge retrieval from large language models
identity.local_path: docs/papers/Had enough of experts Quantitative knowledge retrieval from large language models Selby(2024).pdf
identity.cutoff_status: First-page identity and PDF version stamp inspected; matched API version date no later than cutoff
claims: The study elicits parametric priors and imputes tabular values with LLMs, comparing them with expert/statistical baselines.
Reported imputation generally falls short of KNN/random-forest alternatives; some elicited priors strongly conflict with data.
The authors identify incomplete metadata, ambiguous units and recognizable public datasets as limitations.
identity.inspection_scope: Explicit selected passages, not an assertion that every page was reviewed.
adverse_findings_and_limits: Repeated consistency is not calibration; quantitative prior parameters require external checking.
This is adjacent evidence about elicitation and imputation, not a causal identification or missingness theorem.
identity.project_disposition: Retain as adverse evidence against silent LLM imputation and uncalibrated pseudo-expert priors.
identity.filename_title: Had enough of experts Quantitative knowledge retrieval from large language models

identity.title: OntoLearner: A Modular Python Library for Ontology Learning with Large Language Models
identity.local_path: docs/papers/OntoLearner A Modular Python Library for Ontology Learning with Large Language Models Babaei Giglou(2026).pdf
identity.cutoff_status: First-page identity and PDF version stamp inspected; matched API version date no later than cutoff
claims: OntoLearner describes modular ontology loading, learning tasks and learner models for typing, taxonomy and relation discovery.
The authors report domain-dependent calibration, false-positive/false-negative patterns and retrieval failures.
The requirements discussion explicitly notes developer-defined requirements; paper counts differ across sections and should not be treated as a stable release inventory.
identity.inspection_scope: Explicit selected passages, not an assertion that every page was reviewed.

anchors.section: Domain-dependent failures, discussion and code availability

adverse_findings_and_limits: Taxonomic or semantic relations are not automatically causal edges or measured-variable definitions.
Perplexity and model recognition tests do not prove absence of training contamination.
Bank units, exposure windows and availability clocks still need authoritative definitions.
identity.project_disposition: Candidate ontology tooling only; inspect pinned source/license and evaluate semantic alignment separately from causality.
identity.filename_title: OntoLearner A Modular Python Library for Ontology Learning with Large Language Models

identity.title: Evidence-Grounded Auditing of Identification Assumptions in Climate-Policy Causal Evaluations
identity.local_path: docs/papers/Evidence-Grounded Auditing of Identification Assumptions in Climate-Policy Causal Evaluations Zhang(2026).pdf
identity.cutoff_status: First-page identity and PDF version stamp inspected; matched API version date no later than cutoff
claims: ARGUS audits reported evidence for DiD identifying assumptions and explicitly does not adjudicate causal truth.
The synthetic flaw study shows a retrieval/abstention trade-off: its gated pipeline misses some omissions that ungated ablations flag.
In the small five-paper human-label pilot, weak retrieval produces excessive severity; the reported calibration adjustment is in-sample and untested on unseen papers.
identity.inspection_scope: Explicit selected passages, not an assertion that every page was reviewed.

anchors.section: Human-label pilot, in-sample calibration and discussion

adverse_findings_and_limits: Failure to retrieve evidence is different from absence of evidence in the paper.
Synthetic flaw injection, a general-economics corpus and a small reconciled pilot do not establish climate-policy or bank validation.
High agreement with majority medium labels can mask poor discrimination; author-reported improvements are not external review.
identity.project_disposition: Candidate evidence-audit pattern with retrieval status distinct from scientific risk, and expert adjudication retained.
identity.filename_title: Evidence-Grounded Auditing of Identification Assumptions in Climate-Policy Causal Evaluations

anchors: base/ontology.py from_huggingface, load and import handling
claims: Provides ontology loading and semantic-learning interfaces; load without a path downloads through Hugging Face.
The inspected hf_hub_download call lacks a revision argument; source-code pinning alone does not pin the downloaded ontology.
adverse_findings_and_limits: Use local versioned ontology bytes and explicit units/clocks rather than automatic mutable downloads.
Taxonomy/relation extraction cannot establish causal-edge semantics or audit truth.
Defer installation until dependency/model/license scope is fixed.
